description: This file defines a set of API endpoints related to handling comments on work items within a project management backend. It includes data models, utility functions for database access, and routes for listing and adding comments, leveraging FastAPI and Supabase.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a single comment on a work item.

classes.name: CreateCommentRequest
classes.description: Payload model for creating a new comment on a work item.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: Comment add_comment( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), payload: CreateCommentRequest = ..., supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: API endpoint to add a new comment to a specific work item.
